reviewer: Codex local implementation/self-review; separate raw-record consumers are not independent approval

criteria.conclusion: Ten fresh prerequisites, 13 commands, 3000 frames and 6763 independent process observations. Five fresh-process repetitions with paired tracing; raw samples and exact signed artifact identity retained. Phase clocks are elapsed QPC durations, aggregate CPU uses process counters; tracing deltas are noisy and not subtracted.

Static/hidden/minimized paints are zero. Native caret submits 20 frames in 10.065 s; worker CPU delta 0 ms in quiet phases, 2515.625 ms with caret. Presenter/observer cost remains separately charged. Rust clock/caret uses actual deadlines with skipped elapsed periods; accessibility has no timer.

108 incremental/full comparisons at both resolutions/all scales match exactly; 300 exact layout-key/eviction probes. Old/new bounds, translucency, clips, reorder/removal, scroll, scale, caret/preedit and changed backgrounds are covered. Rich effects, >32 contributions or >60% coverage conservatively repaint fully.

100 measured consecutive file publications after five warm-up cycles at each resolution. Complete checkpoints match after every commit, provider remains fixed and no retired root survives settlement. Exact normalized Rust-live plateau; 704-byte one-time baseline counter Value plus four decimal build-ID bytes explain the 708-byte maximum raw increase. Process/private and cache bounds pass.

Delayed readers retain roots, fourth-root staging rejects without active-state loss and release enables retry. Old/new requested-allocation peaks and completed-build-to-RAM latency are retained separately from building. The 500 ms resource target is missed. Translucent-root rejection now precedes publication in builder and API.

Six-view harness, fonts, bounded caches, observation records, native worker and presenter are accounted as hosted costs; no guest budget or scanout claim. Kernel, scheduler, isolation, drivers, services and guest compositor remain unmeasured. 256 MiB guest cold-idle target is unchanged.

performance_gate: Hosted measurement/stability gate passes; efficiency and guest targets do not. P2-13/M2 remain open.

bounded_followups.trigger: 2899/3000 frames exceed the 16.667 ms elapsed budget
bounded_followups.work: Profile primitive/text/filter work; cull outside damage, reduce full-surface group copies/masks and validate any effect cache dependencies with the unchanged oracle. Retain rich/reduced quality and fixed memory caps.

bounded_followups.trigger: Resource p95 completed-build-to-RAM latency 900.691 ms at 720p and 1107.989 ms at 1080p
bounded_followups.work: Transfer the validated staged frame through an owned generation-tagged presentation lease instead of repainting it, then remeasure 100 cycles including delayed readers/headroom/opacity failures. Do not remove validation or debounce from the metric.

bounded_followups.trigger: Clock/caret costs consume about 9.5–10.4 process CPU seconds in the ten-second six-view timed phase
bounded_followups.work: Tighten caret/clock damage and background invalidation; native full BMP/WinForms copies require separate improvement. Preserve hidden/minimized suspension and report observer costs.

limits: RAM consumer frame/input latency is not native display or guest timing
Elapsed render distributions do not establish per-frame thread CPU cost
Cold means fresh process; OS file cache and host load/power were not isolated
Trace-on/off deltas include host variation; no constant overhead correction is claimed
No retained blur/shadow cache, guest runtime, native IME or native assistive consumer
P2-13 must revalidate clean final selected freestanding linkage and M2 acceptance
